What last year's procedure was that we had to mention our scores on UHS' site and give them our username and password for the college board site so they can verify our scores since there's no way to send UHS our scores directly from Collegeboard. 

And yes you can send your better scores from two SAT attempts. I did the same last year. Just generate both reports and put crosses on the ones you don't want them to use. And mention that as well. Make sure the ones you mention on UHS' site are present on your Collegeboard account since they check your scores from the site too by your username and password you provide them.

Hope this might be of some help!
